data.narrative:
VVater, a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Kevin Gast, has raised $5.79M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 firms across climate and energy—1 public (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix—though direct peer comparables at identical stage and valuation tier proved insufficient for reliable median benchmarking.

A Stage-Progression method was applied, using the $5.79M raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This approach yielded an implied valuation of $14.5M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow peer set; the broader Climate & Energy peer universe (8 companies) does not provide the minimum 3-datapoint threshold needed for reliable median estimation at VVater's specific stage and tier.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $12M (low) to $17M (high), with a median of $14M. This range reflects uncertainty around VVater's stage progression trajectory and the limited availability of precise peer comparables at early stages in frontier-energy verticals. Key sensitivities include capital efficiency relative to peers and the timing of next funding round.
